data.one_liner: Flutter package to create easy slide animation countdown and countup timers.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like `SlideCountdown` and `SlideCountdownSeparated` that display animated sliding numbers for timers. Supports both countdown and countup directions, duration control, and customization of time units and layouts.
use_when: You need an animated countdown or countup timer in your Flutter app.
You want easy control over timer duration (play, pause, resume, seek).
avoid_when: You require complex physics-based motion animations not related to timers.
strengths: Supports both count down and count up
Easy customization of duration layout with `RawSlideCountdown` and `RawDigitItem`
Provides controls for duration (play, pause, resume, seek, add, subtract)
weaknesses: Limited to timer and countdown use cases
